pages.title: Postulate Slate
pages.text: Dark, flat and even: the ground every proof stands on, whether it is seen or not. Found in the Axioms, the Platonic Realm's lowest layer (Y −720 to −650). The Formal Proof Assistant works it into Proof Fragments with Tautology Shards, and makes more from cobblestone and a shard.
